data.title: Make receiver stop and diagnostic finalization reliable (R1)
data.body: Implement R1 only from independently accepted reliability plan docs/implementation/reliability-plan.md at6221e4b0734446606df460a87ca8f66ea72cd279, integrated mainf3983b0c6166828a629212f7f36a00ce8d4e562e. Exact worktree C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/.worktrees/receiver-diagnostics, branchcodex/receiver-diagnostics baselinef3983b0. Six owned files: new native/ffgl-source/src/ReceiverRun.h, modified FrameReceiver.cpp, new tests/native/receiver_run_test.cc, modified tests/native/receiver_lifecycle_test.cc, additive native/CMakeLists.txt target/test registration, native/LIFECYCLE.md. Distinguish pending requested stop from failed/complete/deadline copy outcomes; production helper separately contains diagnostic callback exceptions before existing cleanup; hoisted counters and current-run beginSucceeded guard prevent stale activation attribution; bounded JSON formatter preserves valid failure rows under normal output. Add production-used seam tests for outcome matrix, callback throw/order, formatter controls/truncation, activation attribution and pending/failed ownership retention. No GPU resource completion or timing success inferred from stop/logging. Required focused CPU tests and LuxTracerTR02 build exactly as plan, plus unchanged JS inspector negative tests. No native host, GPU, Studio, Resolume or native filesystem scope. Source-level implementation acceptance requires exact commit/build/test/raw evidence and fresh independent review; root owns separate integration. Vendor prerequisite prepared by root: copied source-only FFGL203files atfda8d4a to isolated native/vendor/ffgl/source/lib, full verified hashes in main docs/conductor-onboarding/receiver-vendor-source-manifest.json. Inspect manifest/destination before build. Do not copy old binaries, download/install, alter reserved C02/source/runtime files, merge or push. User authorizes four-workstream continuation and routine decisions under sole root coordinator.
data.summary:
LUX-14 specification 2 implementation submitted for independent source-worktree review.
Commit c17e679824a0fed79ce52621a0df4fe85cd659d7; branch codex/receiver-diagnostics; exact checkout C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/.worktrees/receiver-diagnostics; baseline f3983b0c6166828a629212f7f36a00ce8d4e562e.
Six assigned files only. Production-used copy outcome classifier distinguishes pending cancellation from failure/deadline while preserving Complete and Failed precedence. Body failure and final diagnostics callbacks are independently contained, then hand off to unchanged cleanup. Current-run beginSucceeded gates attributed drain/summary, including retained and partially initialized IDs. Bounded JSON failure formatter escapes all nonprintable/high bytes, limits input scanning and preserves failure-row fields. Release CPU tests exercise production seams and ownership retention.
Required five native CPU checks pass; receiver DLL compiles; seven JS inspector/options checks pass. The root-confirmed options-only parser path was freshly compiled and executed only through the unchanged test with --validate-options. No graphics initialization, actual host playback, native filesystem harness, DLL loading, GPU timing, Studio or Resolume test was performed. Source acceptance is not main integration or hardware acceptance. Root owns fresh independent review and serial integration.

# LUX-14 source evidence

Executor / host: /root/receiver_diagnostics, stable 401aca40-8398-49ab-9023-5cd132a0efa3, session 4ca1e56c-cbab-4067-bd7d-77c2a0cede0c, claim a2355c22-8cad-4dea-a617-0cf4fcdbe50c. Worktree C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/.worktrees/receiver-diagnostics, branch codex/receiver-diagnostics, baseline f3983b0c6166828a629212f7f36a00ce8d4e562e, submitted source c17e679824a0fed79ce52621a0df4fe85cd659d7. Six-file tested SHA-256 manifest: .superpowers/LUX-14/tested-source-manifest.json. This manifest was recorded after all tests and verified unchanged after commit. All raw log paths below are under that checkout's .superpowers/LUX-14/.

## Prerequisites and identity
- Fresh exact checkout/session verified by session.json, ticket-before-claim.json and claim.json. Root registered host, own ack at epoch1/challenge1 then dynamic ready and exact claim. No inherited managed claim.
- Accepted plan SHA-256 07F6C08E4FCF427CB313173DD1CCC73197F9D0169F1E79526448DA015BD7B60F from source6221e4b; main incorporated it at baseline f3983b0.
- Root vendor manifest C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/docs/conductor-onboarding/receiver-vendor-source-manifest.json SHA-256 0C1925968568652331DC9E4245854D7C1B5D64D88AD59A9339A13AD6E1892356 records FFGL upstream fda8d4a5904eaf09dd97ac0f95c246bd7f9f9a46 source closure. Worker independently compared all203 destination files,3504300bytes: vendor-verification.json. No downloaded sources or copied old binaries/build products.
- build-tools.json records VS discovery and exact tools. Final configure uses CMake supplied by VS18 BuildTools, generator Visual Studio 18 2026, x64, v145,version=14.50.35717, Windows SDK10.0.26100.0. configure-fresh.log records MSVC19.50.35721.0. Final cache flags include /EHsc and Release /O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG.

## Red / setup corrections retained
- New receiver_run_test.cc and additive CMake registration were written before ReceiverRun.h. red-build.log records expected C1083 missing ReceiverRun.h, exit1. Production code remained unchanged until this red.
- First configure.log failed MSB6001 duplicate Path/PATH during CL startup; LUX-P16 53c4c59e-6f1e-4bfa-ba64-b2e79ffb06a4 records exact correction and addendum. Save $env:PATH, Remove-Item Env:PATH, restore $env:Path only within current process before CMake. Corrected configure-normalized.log succeeded. The failed initial configure had left empty cached CXX flags; first green-build.log is superseded. configure-history.yaml preserved, then --fresh configure restored proper flags; final-build.log contains the relevant source build. No machine environment or policy mutation.
- Initial js-tests.log shows6 inspector passes and1 options failure because the intentionally unbuilt standalone executable was absent. Root source inspection clarified the options-only parser precondition. parser-clarification.md and parser-note-result.json record authorization and exact early-return inspection. parser-build.log builds only additional lux_standalone_host from this checkout. The unchanged JS test launches exactly --validate-options, windowsHide:true, timeout3000ms; clears inherited LUX_* and tests accepted cadence/invalid options that return before graphics and before hang filesystem checks. Final7/7 evidence prospectively resolves this setup failure.

## Criteria and actual observations
1. Stop/failure semantics: final-cpu-tests.log receiver_run_cpu passes all12 Complete/Pending/Failed x stop x expired combinations with literal expected results. Dedicated marker skips continuation; actual deadline/query failure strings and unknown exception propagate to failure callback, not cancellation. Independent review must inspect FrameReceiver.cpp uses this classifier at the real copy polling boundary, and that only pending Stop throws the marker before retirement/NV locking/publication.
2. Final diagnostics: receiver_run_cpu runs five body outcomes x four callback-throw combinations; failure/summary/cleanup-handoff order, one summary attempt and no body continuation after stop. Actual failing ostream partial output does not retry or claim a completed row. Bounded production formatter tests quote/backslash, newline/tab/CR, NUL termination, controls/high bytes, null/empty,1023bytes and non-NUL1024byte bound. attribution-tests.log adds and passes no-ID and retained-ID initialization before begin, begin failing before/after ID assignment, successful activation, and reused subsequent runs through production finalizeReceiverDiagnostics. Production begin flag assignment and drain gating require independent source review; fixture does not execute Windows activation. Counts/cap/loss arithmetic retained by source diff.
3. Ownership: final-cpu-tests.log receiver_lifecycle_cpu passes pending->failed->complete cleanup after classified cancellation, with exact retained copy/lease/admission/registration then poll-copy,retire,end-admission,unregister,release. Existing GL,unlock,unregister and lifecycle negatives pass. Production ImportOwnership/CleanupOps unchanged; no physical completion inferred.
4. Coherent build/checks: final-build.log contains successful build of lux_receiver_run_test lux_receiver_lifecycle_test lux_shutdown_race_test lux_shared_ring_test lux_context_handoff_test LuxTracerTR02. final-cpu-tests.log shows5/5 passed under Release. Subsequent test-only no-instance expansion rebuilt lux_receiver_run_test in attribution-build.log and passed receiver_run_cpu in attribution-tests.log. final-js-tests.log shows7/7 passed (6 cadence inspector,1 options suite). Existing warnings: FFGL WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN/NOMINMAX macro redefinitions and old /UNDEBUG overrides; no final no-unwind C4530. LuxTracerTR02.dll SHA256 DD35CB800429E59A0CCC3695E2C31B2C9B846EC57A6CD121FC32ACD67C4AA496. Staged diff whitespace and exact six-file scope passed before commit.
5. Honest limits: native/LIFECYCLE.md records one diagnostic attempt is not guaranteed parseable output, prior/partial initialization cannot attribute summaries, failed output is unavailable, summary precedes resource cleanup, and actual host/driver timing/freshness/clean-machine evidence remains incomplete. Archived hardware artifacts unmodified. No SDK/Studio/public capability change, so no visual skill edit/install was required.

Commands (each native exit guarded):
- CMake --fresh -S native -B native/build -G "Visual Studio 18 2026" -A x64 -T "v145,version=14.50.35717" -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_VERSION=10.0.26100.0
- CMake --build native/build --config Release --target lux_receiver_run_test lux_receiver_lifecycle_test lux_shutdown_race_test lux_shared_ring_test lux_context_handoff_test LuxTracerTR02
- CTest --test-dir native/build -C Release --output-on-failure -R "^(receiver_run_cpu|receiver_lifecycle_cpu|shutdown_admission|shared_ring_ownership|context_handoff_cpu)$"
- CMake --build native/build --config Release --target lux_receiver_run_test; CTest --test-dir native/build -C Release --output-on-failure -R "^receiver_run_cpu$" after no-ID test expansion.
- CMake --build native/build --config Release --target lux_standalone_host (root clarified parser-only prerequisite).
- C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe --test tests/unit/cadence-inspect.test.mjs tests/unit/native-cadence-options.test.mjs

Validated startup corrections matched exact Windows tool/checkout/operation: CON-24 installed Conductor uses require_escalated every time; READ-P9/CON-P38 per-checkout Git -C and safe.directory/core.excludesFile=; process-scoped Git trust via journal helper; bounded stage/commit uses escalation with native exit guards; LUX-P2 register/observe/ownack/ready before claim.
